description: Today Match sources. Every source here is read by its own adapter in scanner/parsers/event_adapters.py, and routing is decided per record from its own status - not from which file it was configured in. Measured 2026-08-20: routing by file would have discarded 95 fixtures (83 NS in axsports, 10 Upcoming in tapmad-bd, 1 LIVE each in the two upcoming-only feeds).

sources.name: SonyLiv Live Matches
sources.note: No status field: isLive + isOnAir carry it. Name built from emfAttributes home_team/away_team so it merges with the other feeds' spelling.

sources.name: AX Sports Live Sports
sources.note: Measured a strict subset of srhady-bingstream: same 87 ids, same 208 stream_links. Kept because it is the group A source named in the brief; dedup folds the overlap.

sources.name: Tapmad BD Matches
sources.note: stream_url present on Live only; the 10 Upcoming records are metadata.

sources.name: Prime Video Free Sports
sources.note: stream_url is a dict of CDN name -> URL: five servers of one channel.

sources.name: TrySports Cricket Live
sources.note: streams[].channel_name is a real broadcaster here (Willow, Willow 2, Willow Sports, Sky Sport 1 NZ).

sources.name: TrySports Football Live
sources.note: streams[].channel_name repeats the match title, so it names no broadcaster and falls through to the generic label.

sources.name: Bingstream Live and Upcoming
sources.note: link_live[] entries are CDN edges of one feed; channel identity is stream_name, else display_name + line.

sources.name: SM Live and Upcoming Sports Data
sources.note: Richest feed: 542 named channels, 311 filled URLs, 63 ClearKey streams, 158 URLs carrying inline |Referer=. status FINISHED is read as an end signal.

sources.name: SM FanCode Auto Update
sources.note: stream_link on the LIVE rows only.

sources.name: CricHD Footy Live Events
sources.note: Keys carry spaces. Channels[] was empty on all 24 records when this was written, so its filled shape is unverified and the reader logs anything it does not recognise.

sources.name: Willow Event Sports
sources.note: stream_url_alpha and _bravo are two different feeds (pdx-nitro vs iad-nitro) = two channels of five servers. The same key is a bare string on upcoming records.
